metadata.description: Four small mods for Claude Code: verified work, context that survives, one to-do list across chats, and hours per client.

plugins.name: done-check
plugins.description: Flags every turn where Claude changed code but ran no build, test or check afterwards, and can send it back to run one. /done

plugins.name: context-keeper
plugins.description: Tells you when to compact, clear or start a new chat, and hands the next chat a short summary of the last one. /coach /backup /restore

plugins.name: command-deck
plugins.description: One list of what needs you across every Claude Code chat on this computer, with tick-off. /deck

plugins.name: billing-meter
plugins.description: Hours per client or project, measured from your Claude Code chats, with CSV timesheets. /bill
